title: 第7章  万化无极功
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
付了钱，陆渊根据那本《青州镇魔司生存指南》内附的地图，很快便来到了精武阁门口。
大门敞开着，里面通透敞亮，几名同僚进出来往。
陆渊刚一跨过门槛，就看到壁画边上站着一道熟悉身影。
那人背对着门，身穿一袭暗纹锦袍，织金大氅上绣有凶虎踏煞纹样，正是之前在县衙正堂见过的那位大人。
若非对方当时不顾周通劝阻赐下腰牌，自己也不可能顺利进入镇魔司。
这是人家对他的好，得
陆渊愣了一下，快步上前，抱拳行礼，“见过大人。”
对方转过身来，眉目威严的脸上的露出一丝温和笑意。
“陆渊，一个时辰斩妖二百七十八只，入门考核甲等，你很不错。”
陆渊笑了笑，“大人过奖了，多谢您赠我腰牌，还没请教您名讳？”
对方也没藏着，“我姓沈名墨，在青州镇魔司任总教头之职。”
总教头？
陆渊眼底闪过一抹意外。
总教头掌管镇魔校尉以下所有成员的晋升考核，职位虽然不高，但这权利却不是一般的大。
在苏定安那本指南中也提到过，总教头沈墨修为深不可测，前些年曾在青州边境斩杀过一只六境大妖。
如此人物，竟然在这里特意等他？
沈墨说罢，转身往楼梯口走去，边走边问，“你对精武阁了解多少？”
陆渊跟了上去，“来之前听人说过，第一层是粗浅功法，第二层是进阶功法，真正的核心功法是在第三层。”
沈墨点头，带着陆渊上到三楼，脚步顿了顿，“你刚入门，按理说只能在三楼以下挑选功法。”
陆渊点头，还没回话就见沈墨迈步直上四楼。

他脚步顿了顿，下意识看向挂在楼梯口的木牌，两列大字写得清清楚楚。
第一列：四层禁地，未经许可禁止入内。
第二列：违者重罚。
沈墨已经上了几级台阶，回过头来露出一丝笑意，“愣着做什么，跟上来。”
陆渊指向那块木牌，“沈大人，这......”
“那是给别人看的，我虽不是什么大人物，但带你上去的权限还是有的。”
陆渊深吸一口气，抬脚跟了上去。
也就是他在入门考核表现优异拿了甲等，换成别人可没这种待遇。
一排排古朴木架上整齐码放着卷轴和簿册。
沈墨脚步轻熟，上楼之后径直向着最深处去。
陆渊跟在后面，目光扫过各类功法。
千面蛊经。
以自身精血喂养本命蛊，蛊成后可寄居体内，改换容貌气息，真假难辨。
修习需承受噬心之痛，且每年需以活人精血饲蛊，否则反噬。
陆渊皱了皱眉，这功法……未免太邪性了。
下一部，镇岳真诀。
观想上古神碑，镇守己身，运功时身如山岳，不动不摇，万法不侵。
缺点是攻击手段匮乏，移动缓慢。
的确是个好功法，但是跟自己的风格不太搭。
“看看这本。”

沈墨的声音从耳边响起，只见对方从最深处的木架上抽出一本簿册。
陆渊接过一看，封面上是几个古朴大字：极御八荒诀。
沈墨负手而立，开口说道：“你在入门考核中出手刚猛，力道惊人，打的是大开大合的路子。”
“这部功法至刚至烈，攻伐无双，一旦练至大成，一拳可碎山岳，一刀可斩江河，和你极为贴切。”
陆渊正想道谢，目光突然被什么吸引。
只见木架最顶上，一本簿册斜靠墙角，那册子比其它的都薄，上面落满灰尘，像是许久没人动过。
“沈大人，那本是什么？”
沈墨目光看去，顺手将那簿册取下，掸去灰尘，露出封面。
万化无极功。
“这部功法......怎么说呢......”
沈墨顿了片刻，语气复杂道：“理念顶尖，但练起来不尽人意。”
陆渊接过，翻开封面看了一眼。
开篇第一句：引灵入体，百炼如铁，千炼成钢，万化无极。
沈墨的声音适时响起。
“这部功法剑走偏锋，修的是内炼之法，将体内灵力淬了又淬，压了又压，好比是炼铁成钢。”
“每练一层，都会引起灵力质的飞跃，使用同样的招式，威力暴涨数倍不止。”
陆渊双眼一亮，这不比刚才那本强？
他正要开口，就听沈墨话锋一转。
“只可惜，现存记录最高也只练到三层，之后就再也练不动了。”
“练不动？”

“嗯，就像炼铁到了极限，没有更强的火力只能止步于此。”
他看向陆渊，正色道：“以你的资质，极御八荒诀是最好的选择，稳扎稳打，将来必成大器。”
陆渊眼底却闪过一抹异色。
淬炼灵力，量变引发质变，这个理论的确顶尖，而且上限很高。
别人练不成，是因为没有更强的内炼之力。
可他有！
【开天】之力，无坚不摧，无物不破，修炼一个万化无极功还不是手拿把掐？
陆渊目光一凝，下定决心，“沈大人，我就要这个了。”
沈墨脸色微变，“什么？”
陆渊扬了扬手中簿册，“万化无极功。”
“你......”沈墨眉头皱起，“这功法没人能突破三层，练不到一半就得卡死，你练这个？”
陆渊正要开口，却被对方抬手打断。
“算了，随你吧，但我丑话说在前面，要是练不下去了立刻来找我，这部极御八荒诀给你留着。”
“多谢沈大人！”陆渊心中一暖，抱拳躬身。
“行了，功法已选，你下去吧。”沈墨没好气地摆了摆手。
陆渊嘿嘿一笑，躬身告退。
......
回到分配给新人的山下草舍。
万化无极功摆在桌上。
服下蜕凡丹，引灵入体运行功法。

一股精纯至极的能量从丹田迸发，疯狂涌入四肢百骸，所过之处，血肉筋骨都在颤抖。
万化无极功运转，丝丝缕缕的灵力如清晨薄雾被引入经脉，在体内有序运行。
在【悟性逆天】的效果之下，陆渊终于体会到什么叫做修习天地万法如掌上观纹。
每一条经脉都像活了一样，在他脑海中清晰呈现。
这处慢，那处快，这处停，那处要转个圈......
就好像功法运行路线早已打通，他只需要跟着走一遍。
入百汇，经任脉下行，过丹田，转督脉上行，再回百汇。
一路顺畅地像溪水下山。
一个周天走完，灵力明显变得更加浑厚凝实。
陆渊睁开双眼，一抹精芒在眼底隐现。
万化无极功第一层。
content_en:
After paying the money, Lu Yuan quickly arrived at the entrance of Jingwu Pavilion based on the map included in the "Qingzhou Demon Suppressor Survival Guide".
The door was open, and the inside was bright and bright, with several colleagues going in and out.
As soon as Lu Yuan crossed the threshold, he saw a familiar figure standing beside the mural.
The man had his back to the door. He was wearing a brocade robe with dark patterns and a gold-woven cloak embroidered with a fierce tiger stampede pattern. He was the man he had seen in the main hall of the county government before.
If the other party hadn't given him a waist card despite Zhou Tong's dissuasion, he wouldn't have been able to successfully enter the Demon Suppression Division.
This is because people are kind to him, so
Lu Yuan was stunned for a moment, then quickly stepped forward, cupped his fists and saluted, "I have met you, sir."
The other party turned around, with a gentle smile on his majestic face.
"Lu Yuan, you killed two hundred and seventy-eight demons in one hour, and you are ranked first in the entrance examination. You are very good."
Lu Yuan smiled and said, "Thank you, sir. Thank you for giving me the badge. I haven't asked you for your name yet?"
The other party didn't hide it, "My surname is Shen Mingmo, and I serve as the chief instructor in the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division."
Chief coach?
A flash of surprise flashed in Lu Yuan's eyes.
The chief instructor is in charge of the promotion assessment of all members below the Demon Suppressing School Captain. Although his position is not high, his power is not ordinary.
It was also mentioned in Su Ding'an's guide that the head coach Shen Mo's cultivation was unfathomable, and he had killed a six-realm monster on the border of Qingzhou a few years ago.
Such a person is waiting for him here?
After Shen Mo finished speaking, he turned around and walked towards the stairs. As he walked, he asked, "How much do you know about Jingwu Pavilion?"
Lu Yuan followed, "I heard someone say before I came here that the first level is rough skills, the second level is advanced skills, and the real core skills are on the third level."
Shen Mo nodded and led Lu Yuan up to the third floor. He paused and said, "You have just started. Logically speaking, you can only choose exercises below the third floor."
Lu Yuan nodded, and before he could reply, he saw Shen Mo walking straight up to the fourth floor.
He paused and subconsciously looked at the wooden sign hanging at the top of the stairs. Two columns of large characters were written clearly.
The first column: the fourth level of forbidden areas, entry without permission is prohibited.
Second column: Violators will be severely punished.
Shen Mo had already climbed a few steps. He turned around and smiled, "What are you doing here? Follow me."
Lu Yuan pointed to the wooden sign, "Master Shen, this..."
"That's for others to see. Although I'm not a big shot, I still have the authority to take you up there."
Lu Yuan took a deep breath, raised his feet and followed.
That is to say, he performed well in the entrance examination and received an A-level. Others would not have received this kind of treatment.
Scrolls and books are neatly stacked on rows of simple wooden shelves.
Shen Mo's steps were light and familiar. After going upstairs, he went straight to the deepest point.
Lu Yuan followed behind, scanning the various techniques.
Thousand Faces Gu Sutra.
Feed the natal poison with your own essence and blood. After the poison becomes mature, it can live in the body and change its appearance and breath. It is difficult to distinguish the true from the false.
To practice, you need to bear the heart-gnawing pain, and you need to feed the gu with the essence and blood of living people every year, otherwise it will backfire.
Lu Yuan frowned, this technique... was too evil.
The next part, Zhenyue Zhenjue.
Visualize the ancient sacred monument to guard your body. When exercising your power, your body is like a mountain, unshakable and invulnerable to all forces.
The disadvantages are lack of attack methods and slow movement.
It's indeed a good technique, but it doesn't quite match my style.
"Look at this."
Shen Mo's voice rang from his ears, and he saw the other party pulling out a book from the deepest wooden shelf.
Lu Yuan took it and took a look. On the cover were a few simple characters: Jiyu Bahuang Jue.
Shen Mo stood with his hands behind his back and said, "In the entrance examination, you shot fiercely and with amazing strength. You hit a wide open path."
"This technique is extremely strong and powerful, and its attack is unparalleled. Once practiced to its full potential, you can break mountains with one punch and cut rivers with one sword. It is very suitable for you."
Lu Yuan was about to say thank you when his eyes were suddenly attracted by something.
On the top of the wooden shelf, I saw a book leaning against the corner. The book was smaller thanThe others were thin and covered with dust, as if no one had touched them for a long time.
"Master Shen, what is that book?"
Shen Mo looked at it, took off the book, dusted it off, and revealed the cover.
The infinite power of all transformations.
"This technique...how should I put it..."
Shen Mo paused for a moment and said in a complex tone: "The concept is top-notch, but the practice is unsatisfactory."
Lu Yuan took it and took a look at the cover.
The first sentence of the opening chapter: Introducing the spirit into the body, it can be refined like iron a hundred times, steel can be made into steel after a thousand tempers, and it can be transformed into endless things.
Shen Mo's voice sounded at the right time.
"This skill is a deviant approach. It is a method of internal refining. It tempers the spiritual power in the body again and again, and presses it again, just like smelting iron into steel."
"Each level of practice will cause a leap in spiritual power. Using the same moves, the power will increase several times."
Lu Yuan's eyes lit up, isn't this better than the one just now?
Just as he was about to speak, Shen Mo changed the subject.
"It's a pity that the highest existing record is only up to the third level, and you can't practice anymore after that."
"Can't practice?"
"Well, it's like iron smelting reaching its limit. Without stronger firepower, it can only stop here."
He looked at Lu Yuan and said seriously: "With your qualifications, Ji Yu Ba Huang Jue is the best choice. If you work steadily, you will become a great weapon in the future."
Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with a strange color.
Tempering spiritual power, quantitative changes lead to qualitative changes, this theory is indeed top-notch, and the upper limit is very high.
Others cannot practice it because they don’t have stronger inner strength.
But he does!
The power of [Open Heaven] is indestructible and indestructible to all things. Isn’t it better to practice the Wanhua Wuji Gong with just one hand?
Lu Yuan's eyes narrowed and he made up his mind, "Master Shen, I want this."
Shen Mo's face changed slightly, "What?"
Lu Yuan raised the book in his hand and said, "Wanhua Wuji Kung Fu."
"You..." Shen Mo frowned, "No one can break through the third level of this technique. If you don't practice it halfway, you will get stuck. Are you practicing this?"
Lu Yuan was about to speak, but was interrupted by the other party raising his hand.
"Forget it, it's up to you, but I'll say something ugly before you. If you can't practice anymore, come to me immediately. I'll keep this Eight Desolations of Ultimate Control for you."
"Thank you, Master Shen!" Lu Yuan felt warm in his heart and bowed with his fists clasped.
"Okay, the technique has been selected, you can go down." Shen Mo waved his hand angrily.
Lu Yuan chuckled and bowed to leave.
...
Return to the hut at the foot of the mountain assigned to the newcomers.
The Wanhua Wuji Kung is on the table.
Take the Shedding Pill to introduce the spirit into the body to perform the exercises.
An extremely pure energy burst out from the dantian and poured into the limbs and bones crazily. Wherever it passed, the flesh, blood, muscles and bones were trembling.
The Wanhua Wuji Gong operates, and strands of spiritual power are introduced into the meridians like mist in the morning, and run orderly in the body.
Under the effect of [Comprehension Against Heaven], Lu Yuan finally realized what it means to practice all the laws of heaven and earth like observing patterns on the palm of your hand.
Every meridian seemed to be alive, clearly presented in his mind.
Slow here, fast there, stop here, turn around there...
It was as if the exercise route had already been opened and he just needed to follow it.
It enters Baihui, goes down through Ren meridian, passes through Dantian, turns to Du meridian and goes up, and then returns to Baihui.
The journey was as smooth as a stream going down the mountain.
After a week, the spiritual power has obviously become stronger and more solid.
Lu Yuan opened his eyes, and a gleam of light appeared in his eyes.
The first level of Wanhua Wuji Gong.
